upsert.title: Enveda CASMI 2026: Molecule ID From Mass Spectra (Kaggle)
upsert.summary: Online Kaggle machine-learning competition, co-hosted by Enveda and Kaggle, to predict 2-D chemical structures of molecules from LC-MS/MS spectra. Rules acceptance and team merger close 7 Dec 2026 23:59 UTC; final submissions close 14 Dec 2026 23:59 UTC.
upsert.eligibility: Kaggle users aged 18+ (or local age of majority); solo or teams of up to 5. Residents of Crimea, the Donetsk and Luhansk regions, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and persons under US sanctions are excluded. Winners must license solutions under MIT. Taken from an aggregator summary; confirm on the Kaggle rules page.

prize.description: US$50,000 cash prize pool for the top 5 teams: 1st US$16,000, 2nd US$12,000, 3rd US$9,000, 4th US$7,000, 5th US$6,000.

notes: Prize breakdown and deadlines come from an aggregator summary and the 50,000 pool is confirmed by a Digg/Kaggle news item (entry deadline 7 Dec); the official Kaggle competition page was not opened, so entry status is check.
